description: Physics-lumped back-pressure / extraction steam-turbine CHP. Rankine steam path with isentropic turbine expansion (IAPWS-IF97-simplified enthalpy correlations) supplying process/district heat from the exhaust/extraction steam, coupled to a lumped boiler+steam thermal-mass transient ODE (scipy.solve_ivp).

unit.name: Generic 10 MW_e Back-Pressure Steam Turbine CHP
unit.source: Moran, Shapiro, Boettner & Bailey (2018) Fundamentals of Engineering Thermodynamics, 9th ed., Wiley (Rankine cycle, Ch. 8); Kehlhofer et al. (2009) Combined-Cycle Gas & Steam Turbine Power Plants, 3rd ed., PennWell; US EPA CHP Catalog (2017); IAPWS-IF97 (Wagner & Kretzschmar 2008).

T_steam_in_C.note: Superheated live-steam temperature at turbine inlet

P_back_bar.note: Back-pressure (turbine exhaust / extraction) pressure delivering useful process/district heat

eta_boiler.note: Boiler combustion-to-steam thermal efficiency (fuel LHV basis)

T_heat_return_C.note: Process/district-heat condensate return temperature; sets useful-heat sink

m_thermal_kg.note: Lumped thermal mass of boiler water+steel+steam inventory

cp_thermal.note: Effective lumped heat capacity (steel + water/steam mix)

UA_loss.note: Boiler envelope heat-loss conductance to ambient

tau_fuel_s.note: First-order boiler fuel/firing response time constant

PLR_min.note: Minimum stable part-load ratio (sliding pressure limit)
